meta.title: How to Make Vietnam’s Most Famous Coffees 🇻🇳 | Egg, Coconut & Salt Coffee
meta.description:
Vietnamese coffee is on another level 🇻🇳☕ Today, I’m learning how to make three of Vietnam’s most famous coffees: egg coffee, coconut coffee, and salt coffee!

Vietnam has one of the most unique coffee cultures in the world, and Vietnamese coffee goes way beyond the traditional cà phê sữa đá. From the thick, creamy texture of Vietnamese egg coffee (cà phê trứng) to refreshing coconut coffee (cà phê cốt dừa) and the sweet and salty combination of Vietnamese salt coffee (cà phê muối), I wanted to learn how these famous drinks are actually made.

In this video, we make and try:

☕ Vietnamese Egg Coffee (Cà Phê Trứng)
🥥 Vietnamese Coconut Coffee (Cà Phê Cốt Dừa)
🧂 Vietnamese Salt Coffee (Cà Phê Muối)

If you’re traveling to Vietnam, love Vietnamese food and coffee, or want to know how to make Vietnamese coffee at home, this video gives you a look at three Vietnamese coffee drinks you absolutely need to try.

Which Vietnamese coffee would you try first: egg, coconut, or salt? 🇻🇳
